(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 hole (D12) is a tight fit but no allowance is made for the plating thickness specified in the surface treatment field; plating buildup will shrink the bore and cause assembly interference. The designer should either increase the nominal size, add a pre-plate tolerance note, or call out masking of the bore before plating."

,"recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying that the H7 tolerance applies after plating, or adjust the pre-plate hole size to account for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."}]}
